\textit{Note.} World frame, no alignment; same GNSS samples for every estimator; indoor sensor set: IMU, downward flow and downward LiDAR only. H4.1 PASS 3/3 (the FGO whole-flight batch is below both filters' live tracks) [c]; H4.3 PASS (the FGO whole-flight batch against the smoothed UKF within 1--5\%, Table 5.2). The former 'FGO whole-flight batch \textasciitilde{}2$\times$ better than the smoothed UKF' is WITHDRAWN (a noise-model artefact).\par
\textit{Note.} Ordering verdicts used in the footnotes: RULE MET = a pre-registered rule was applied and met, so its ordering (or similarity) is claimed; case (i) TEST RUN, RULE NOT MET = a pre-registered decision rule with a 'no ordering' outcome was applied and gave that outcome; case (ii) FAILED AS WORDED = a pre-registered prediction of an ordering or a similarity was scored literally and is false, which does not by itself establish the opposite ordering; case (iii) NO COMPARATIVE TEST REGISTERED = values are descriptive. n always names its unit (flights, bags, losses).\par
\textit{Note.} [a] Ordering basis, Experiment 4 live tracks indoors, EKF3, UKF and FGO (H4.2). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, over the 123 s without GNSS, m. n = 3 flights (every estimator on the same flights, open loop on simulator truth, paired). Rule: H4.2 'live indoor errors are similar': in every flight the largest live indoor RMSE is $\le$ 1.5 $\times$ the smallest; no ordering test was registered. Result: max $\div$ min 1.71--1.84: H4.2 NOT MET; EKF3 largest in 3 of 3 flights; UKF 0.77--0.84 m and FGO 0.83--0.89 m (both descriptive). Verdict: case (ii), FAILED AS WORDED: the registered prediction is false as written; a failed criterion does not by itself establish an ordering, so any ordering shown is descriptive.\par
\textit{Note.} [b] Ordering basis, Experiment 4, the FGO whole-flight batch against the smoothed UKF (H4.3). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, m. n = 3 flights (same flights, paired). Rule: H4.3: the two RMSEs within 1.5$\times$ of each other in every flight. Result: max $\div$ min 1.01--1.02: H4.3 PASSES; which is lower changes between flights (descriptive). Verdict: RULE MET: the similarity is claimed (no ordering).\par
\textit{Note.} [c] Ordering basis, Experiment 4, the FGO whole-flight batch (hindsight) against the EKF3 and UKF live tracks (H4.1). Metric: indoor horizontal RMSE in the world frame, no alignment, m. n = 3 flights (same flights, paired). Rule: H4.1: PASS iff in 3/3 flights the FGO-batch indoor RMSE is $<$ both EKF3's and the UKF's live indoor RMSE. Result: lower than both in 3 of 3 flights: H4.1 PASSES (a hindsight track against live tracks, not like with like). Verdict: RULE MET: the ordering is claimed.\par
